text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains. Try to avoid too much sugar and fast food. Second, exercise regularly. Even a short walk every day can make a big difference. Third, get enough sleep, because your body needs rest to stay strong. Don't forget your mental health: talk to friends, relax, and take breaks when you feel stressed. Finally, keep a good work-life balance. Spend time on your job, but also enjoy hobbies and family. These simple habits can help you feel happier and healthier every day.
